name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Digital Marketing Strategist | SEO, Paid Media & AI-Driven Search
summary: Digital marketing operator with 15+ years in B2B SaaS and MarTech, running SEO, paid media, and conversion optimization hands-on as founder of Solenzo. Builds the AI-agent systems and automation that are reshaping how buyers and search engines find and evaluate information, giving me a practical, ground-level view of the shift toward AI-driven search rather than a theoretical one. Comfortable moving fast without a large team, translating platform performance into clear recommendations for stakeholders and executives.

Architect and deploy autonomous, AI-driven marketing systems, translating stakeholders' generalized ideas into precise, structured AI prompts and agent instructions.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering insights to executive stakeholders.
